notes.title: Update Notes - Feb 25th, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

First of all, we are aware that it’s been a while since our last update was released but we have prepared a huge update including new content and features. Also, we want you to consider that Jack Walker: Ethereal is our first game as ROG Team which means sometimes we proceed as we learn new techniques and methods.The reason for the prolongation between updates is that we add new maps and content. We continue to improve the game. Let’s see what’s inside: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38653555/5dde7548ea8fba017e4d6b81d4395575078aaacf.png

New features

- New contract (Robot Factory) is available now!
- New Enemies! 

- Economy system is added (Credits) 
- Weapon & Skill Upgrader machine is added to your spaceship 
- Weapon customization is also available now in your spaceship 

Improvements

- New UI for Inventory 
- Improved interaction system 
- Alien planet Spider Queen (Boss) behaviour improvement 
- Spawn, Settings and Saving systems improvement

Fixes

- Fixed a physics bug that caused players to fall off the map.
- Fixed an issue preventing players from replenishing ammo.
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to die instantly when fired with a laser beam.
- Fixed an issue causing laser bullets to hang in the mid air.

notes.title: Fifth Fixed Update For Jack Walker : Ethereal
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here are some of the improvements we made on this week’s update! 

- Slow motion ability in Survival mode is fixed.
- The UI in Survival mode is improved in terms of ergonomics.
- Obstruction problems are fixed.
- Pistol and sword are set to be in your initial inventory.
- Settings menu is set to save your preferences.
- Teleportation problem at the beginning of the game for Oculus Quest users is fixed.


Upcoming Contract
Robot Factory’s general flow and AI behaviors are in progress now. We optimized the level and made polish on level design (depth, detail, interaction) and lightning. Here is a little sneak peek from inside!

notes.title: Fourth Fixed Update For Jack Walker : Ethereal
notes.content:
HELLO EVERYONE !

This week was all about bug fixing and the new level that we have been working on !
Some of our Jack Walker players had movement issues with the "seated mode" which are now fixed by our development team. Also there were a few bugs with the menu interaction system which are gone now. Next, in the new level (Robot Factory map), we have found a few collision and visual bugs, they are fixed now. Finally, some of our Oculus Quest users had teleportation problems at the beginning of the game which was device spesific, we are working on it. Of course, there was performance improvements in terms of optimization and smaller bugs not worth of mention have been covered too.

notes.title: Second Fixed Update For Jack Walker : Ethereal
notes.content:
MAJOR CHANGES ON THE SECOND UPDATE

The key binding settings of Valve Index are fixed.
Some sound effect problems are fixed. 
Some particle effects that caused problems are fixed.
Some enemies used to get out of the map for no reason, it's fixed.
Sometimes, the player couldn't respawn, it's fixed.
A new map is in progress, it'll be available probably next week.
Some players had a rendering issue, it's fixed.
A rare issue about the left hand and storing weapons in the inventory has been fixed.
Sometimes enemies did not take damage from us, it's fixed.
Often players got stuck in maps, it's fixed.
A bug about shooting laser when our hand is in its place has been fixed.

notes.title: First Fixed Update For Jack Walker : Ethereal
notes.content:
The planned update is include fixes for some audio issues, optimization improvements, minor bug fixes, and initial adjustments for Valve Index. We will be taking a big step forward for our Valve Index support from today. We're working on some major game-disrupting bugs in the second map. 

In the following weeks, we will have a fixed update on Wednesdays and we will work on errors in order of importance. Thank you all for supporting us during this time.

Apart from our fixed updates, we will release an update as soon as we solve major bugs that spoil the game pleasure and we will announce it from here and from our official discord channel.
You can send us any bug you have experienced via HELP & BUG REPORT channels in our discord server.

You can access to our discord server from here.
